label: OpenID Connect provider (Sync Gateway)
type: a configured external OIDC identity provider Sync Gateway can validate ID Tokens against, optionally auto-registering a Sync Gateway user on successful validation (register=true) and mapping token claims onto channels/roles.
note: Described in near-identical terms to sgw:local-jwt-provider (both grant channels/roles via a configurable claim name, both have register/disable_session/user_prefix fields), but no source page states Local JWT is 'OIDC without the external issuer' - an isAnalogousTo relation was considered and deliberately not minted, since that predicate requires the docs themselves to draw the comparison.
